description: A celestial creature sent to the earthly realm in a test of talents to select the next trusted advisor to Emperor Yu, energetic and vivacious Monkey sought to carve her own legend in dramatic form.Part truth, part exaggeration, and all bombast, Ukie's first contact with her upright cousins was to accidentally clock two upside the head with a pair of borrowed tonfas and pounce on the third. It took a total time-out to stop their rehearsal from dissolving into a brawl, and amid some rather sheepish apologies, the troupe realized they had caught her antics on tape. It was then they saw the primal grace of a much-beloved cultural legend reenacted by this strange, impish girl who seemed to have appeared out of nowhere.To this day, the troupe still isn't sure if Ukie takes method acting to an extreme, but that hasn't done anything to deter them from welcoming their new leading role.As word of their exciting new addition spread, many flocked to the little town to catch a glimpse of Ukie's electrifying renditions of the Great Sage's many adventures. A born trickster, his mischievous exploits are well known across the land—as many celestial beings as evil spirits had tasted the business end of the Great Sage's legendary staff.For the celestial monkey in Ukie, there was surely no better role. By acting out the mighty spirit of a beloved legend, she displayed not only her talents, but proved that the world of mankind was inextricably tied with that of the other realms. Perhaps only Emperor Yu knows if there truly was ever one such Great Sage—otherwise known as the "Monkey King"...
summon: Witness me! I, who have defied demons and triumphed over all evil!I shall journey ever westward—wait what? Not again...
fusion: I'll take this one, that one, and......Look, I'm just really hungry, okay?Yes. All the time!
evolution: Ohh, I feel great!Like I'm dancing on clouds and stuff!That's not weird, is it?
